fixture_name: Cloverleaf-to-urban interchange conversion — INT preliminary design (Wikimedia PD geometry)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Shortened collector-distributor weave carrying a recorded 1,100 pcu/h design-year peak flow is a substantive lane-change/sideswipe/rear-end exposure issue squarely relevant at preliminary design for this motorway interchange scheme.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Verbatim EV-IN-004 quote confirms PIARC motorway checklists exist for the preliminary-design stage, supporting the pivotal apply-now claim, and geometry/volume rest on recorded inputs, though the quote does not itself name weaving sections.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern within the qualified INT/PIARC baseline with stage-appropriate checklist semantics; HSM Part C/IHSDM are offered as supplementary analysis without conflating compliance questions with the safety concern.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and viable: named checklist application, defined analytical routes (HSM interchange crash prediction or IHSDM), and conditional remedial actions (lengthen weave, ramp metering) tied to a clear trigger.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRU relevance explicitly considered and resolved — grade-separated shared-use paths mean no VRU exposure to the motorised weave, so the scope to vehicle occupants is a documented non-applicability acknowledgment.

justifications.substance: Free-flow ramp entries leaving uncontrolled crossings for shared-use path users directly conflicts with the recorded VRU continuity objectives and represents a real collision-risk design deficiency identifiable at preliminary design.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Scheme-specific claims rest on recorded input facts (objectives, retained shared-use paths, free-flow loops) and the pivotal VRU-accountability claim is backed by a verbatim EV-IN-005 quote; only the 'northern' loop detail in the recommendation exceeds recorded support.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly filed as safety_concern with the PIARC/Austroads material used as supporting audit-framework basis rather than a compliance demand, keeping the categorical distinction intact and fitting the qualified int:preliminary-design baseline.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and viable at this stage (thematic audit application, Walkability Checklist/CQSI tools, controlled or grade-separated crossings at each path/ramp interface), though the unprompted 'northern' location specification lacks recorded backing.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians and cyclists are the explicit focus throughout—affected users named, the uncontrolled-crossing exposure analysed, and mitigations targeted squarely at VRU safety.
